summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the filing of its annual report on Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, and an updated technical report for its El Domo copper-gold project in Ecuador. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure by a foreign private issuer; it does not involve any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. There are no deal terms, prices, premiums, or advisors mentioned. The filing is purely informational and periodic in nature, with no event-driven catalyst.
